summary.text: A 71-year-old woman with lung adenocarcinoma (pT3N1M0, Stage IIIA) underwent right upper lobectomy with lymph node dissection and two cycles of adjuvant cisplatin and vinorelbine. A new right lower lobe nodule suggested recurrence, and further resection or radiation was not pursued because of severe obstructive ventilatory impairment from chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. Her history also included left breast cancer on ongoing letrozole, hypertension, dyslipidemia and a 33-pack-year smoking history.

Pembrolizumab, carboplatin and pemetrexed were started, with prophylactic pegfilgrastim on day two. On day eight of the first cycle she presented with fever and anorexia; on admission she had a temperature of 38.5°C, conjunctival pallor, and systemic erythema with oral mucosal lesions, and laboratory tests showed pancytopenia, elevated C-reactive protein, liver and kidney dysfunction and tumor markers within normal range.

A hematologic immune-related adverse event was suspected, and pulse glucocorticoid therapy and bone marrow aspiration and biopsy were performed. The marrow was severely hypocellular with a marked decrease in nucleated cells and megakaryocytes and mild gelatinous changes, and irAE-induced aplastic anemia was diagnosed. Glucocorticoid, filgrastim, meropenem, caspofungin and transfusions were given, and cyclosporine was started on day 16, but pancytopenia persisted.

On day 24 the white blood cell count had improved to 5,770/μL while thrombocytopenia persisted, and eltrombopag was added. The platelet count gradually improved to 13.4 × 10⁴/μL and she was discharged on day 34. Only one cycle of chemotherapy plus immunotherapy was given, a partial response was maintained, and she continues outpatient follow-up with sustained normalization of all three blood cell lineages.

article_limitations: Table 1 rows 1 to 14 describe published cases from the literature (reference column) and are not recorded as facts of the index patient.
Literature-review, mechanism, guideline and trial statements in the introduction and discussion are not patient facts.

Figure 2 plots the clinical course (drug bars, transfusion and pegfilgrastim arrows, WBC, Hb, platelet and CRP curves); values and drug doses printed or plotted in the image are pixel content in visual.json and are not stated as facts, except where the text states them.
Case text and Figure 1 caption disagree on the lobe of the pre-surgery mass (right upper versus right lower); both statements are review_only.
The text gives no calendar dates beyond February 2024; no dates were computed from relative times.
Dates of surgery, adjuvant chemotherapy and the first chemotherapy plus immunotherapy cycle are not stated.
